slices.writer: PM read-only -> Memory owner/Builder if C
slices.outcome: Quota and retention paths are classified A/B/C/D against real SQL and restart evidence.
slices.acceptance: A candidate-bound audit identifies every quota-related DELETE/UPDATE path and proves either retained evidence or a minimal protective fix without changing explicit forget/privacy deletion.

slices.outcome: All owner clauses have an existing owner, correction pointer, or new slice.
slices.acceptance: The crosswalk and reverse inventory identify every mandatory clause, prohibition, exclusion and external dependency without changing central state.

slices.outcome: Reply and one-message transformations are compared through the existing L1/Writer path.
slices.acceptance: A redact-safe trace contains source, assembled context, plan, Writer input, raw completion, guards and delivered payload with lengths and reason codes.

slices.outcome: Users select human-readable timezones while ChatClock remains the source of truth.
slices.acceptance: Desktop/mobile tests show search, inheritance, DELETE override, DST and honest 403/409/422/tzdata errors without saving unconfirmed selections.

slices.outcome: Status and Analytics expose safe current projections to authorized viewers and moderators.
slices.acceptance: Scoped read requests return real data or 'Нет данных'; prompts, secrets, PII and financial details remain absent for unauthorized roles.

slices.outcome: Backend authorization remains authoritative across scope and stale-session changes.
slices.acceptance: Direct endpoint calls, client-role spoofing, altered X-Chat-Id, stale sessions and role changes cannot cross scope or mutate protected resources.

slices.outcome: Collages, albums and sequential photos resolve with stable ordered assets and honest completeness.
slices.acceptance: Album scenarios report registered/analyzed/delivered counts, preserve target identity through Reply/restart/duplicate updates and never substitute neighboring media.

slices.outcome: Bot-generated media is registered from the returned Telegram Message and reusable after restart.
slices.acceptance: A successful send stores outgoing message/file provenance; Reply reuses analysis without another generation, while failed send or failed analysis is reported honestly.

slices.outcome: One additive/reused payment contract is frozen before implementation.
slices.acceptance: The contract names one order/receipt/ledger/inbox/outbox identity model, rollback and feature-flag boundaries, excludes Platega/Stars/crypto/15-minute TTL, and keeps new PG tables, wallet identity via secret+URL+form receiver, history crediting off, fail-closed personal quota, provider OFF and no services/speech.py as binding constraints.
slices.next: Builder after PAY-ARCH design closure (implementation acceptance is separate)

slices.outcome: Free and paid image balances are isolated, atomic and auditable.
slices.acceptance: Bounded concurrent/restart tests prove chat-user isolation, free-first semantics, 0=unlimited only for the new setting, nonnegative ledger arithmetic and no double spend.

slices.outcome: Orders and payment forms use opaque stable snapshots without mandatory expiration.
slices.acceptance: Repeated clicks reuse one intent, price/pack snapshots remain stable, gateway uses verified server fields and UI cleanup does not delete financial history.

slices.outcome: Signed notifications and optional history reconciliation credit exactly once.
slices.acceptance: HMAC-SHA256, receiver/label/currency/amount checks, durable inbox, unique operation_id and shared confirm_receipt reject invalid/replayed/test events.

slices.outcome: Quota and credit events publish one bounded authorial message or exact fallback.
slices.acceptance: Each unique event makes at most one existing-model attempt through mca_authorial_speech.authorial_system (no services/speech.py, no second prompt registry); exact placeholders/fallback and buttons are verified, and LLM never determines financial facts.

slices.outcome: Existing image-generation admin section edits effective payment/quota/event settings.
slices.acceptance: 50->75, free, pack and event-version changes commit server-side, hot-apply to new orders, preserve old snapshots and survive restart; unauthorized writes fail.

slices.outcome: PAY-01..PAY-58 are covered by bounded grouped simulations.
slices.acceptance: Unit, integration, fault-injection and bounded concurrency artifacts prove grouped quota, ledger, adapter, RBAC, settings and restart invariants without real payment URLs.

slices.outcome: Real provider readiness is separately classified without blocking OFF engineering delivery.
slices.acceptance: Evidence distinguishes DONE_BY_AGENTS, OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED and UNVERIFIED; no payment is LIVE_VERIFIED without real receipt, provider conditions and permitted credentials.

slices.outcome: Nostalgia never publishes a mechanically truncated response.
slices.acceptance: Overlength/cutoff/envelope failures produce complete bounded text or honest unpublishable status, with no second LLM call or new hard word limit.

slices.outcome: Existing nostalgia worker supplies evidence-grounded temporary episode projections.
slices.acceptance: Candidate source refs, participant identity, chronology, uncertainty and current-context relation are preserved without a second memory or unrelated-story concatenation.

slices.outcome: Real nostalgia cases are evaluated for coherence, attribution and relevance.
slices.acceptance: Both owner examples and a bounded real-run sample have source/payload/decision/delivery evidence and an independent baseline comparison; no prompt-only acceptance.
